moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-data-story-timeline-trail, written here): Whole line drawn faint (5 points). A marker scrubs along x with linear keys: 650-1550 ms to the 3rd point, hold to 1850, to the end by 2750; the line left of the marker redrawn thick in accent (clip at marker x); dot on the line + value tag; time rail below with a handle at the same x and a dashed drop line. Return 3450-3950 easeInOut. Optional cursor dragging the handle. Params: points (5) · stop: điểm dừng (điểm 3) · duration kéo (2.1 s).
